c: Prism Lass fires a blade shaped projectile in the direction that the player is moving or last moved. The blade will slice through all enemies in its path, performing a large slash at the end of it. Both the initial projectile and slash can increase in
, and the projectile's travel distance is determined by
affects how many projectiles are fired at once, with every second projectile being fired in the opposite direction that the player is facing.
When playing as Probotector, the projectiles will use a blue tinted version of his melee attack animation, it will only be a blue blade with other characters.
Upon hitting an enemy, Prism Lass has a 5% chance to freeze them. This chance is affected by
